thread:
carla: Heads-up: follow-up thread for the short-lived TLS spike during yesterday's route-flap. collecting owners + ETAs here.

javier: ack. quick recap please?

carla: recap: control-plane push triggered simultaneous route-propagation and a registrar refresh that left some edges with stale route tuples. when clients retried they bounced across regions and we saw a brief TLS handshake surge and increased dropped flows.

tom: so two parts: (1) control-plane should avoid emitting intermediate inconsistent route sets, (2) edge/registrar TTL handling needs tightening.

emily: i'll take (2). open ticket with registrar; ask for explicit support of sub-1min TTLs and cache invalidation API. ETA: ticket + contact by EOD.

dee: i'll own (1). plan: add a route-versioning step and a short write-ack window before promoting new route. also add a server-side CB on route-update failures. ETA: prototype in 36h.

javier: i'll add telemetry and two alerts: (a) region-swap-rate > 5% in 3m -> Pager, (b) tls-handshake-rate delta > 200% in 1m -> SRE page. ETA: 2h for dashboards. link: https://console.redwood/intern/dash/route-flap/2785554321

carla: Action items:
1) dee 1 route-versioning + write-ack gating + CB on route-update failures (36h)
2) emily 1 registrar ticket + edge TTL alignment (EOD)
3) javier 1 telemetry + alerts + dashboard (2h)
4) tom 1 testbed replay + TLS handshake synthetic probe (start in 24h, run 48h)
Please append PRs / tickets here when available.

dee: WIP branch: github.com/redwood/control-plane/pull/4502 - adds versioned route write and simple CB. still needs unit tests.

emily: registrar ticket RG-12198: https://support.registrar.example/tickets/12198 - asking for cache-control support + explicit purge API. added edge-team (cc @tom).

javier: synthetic probe: syn-44712 scheduled to run tomorrow; will simulate route-update 500 + mixed TTLs and report tls-handshake/sec.

tom: testbed job tj-5567 queued. will run replay using s3://redwood-incidents/2785554321/sample-traces.tar.gz

carla: small log snippets from the incident:
```
[2027-08-01T02:14:05Z] route-propagate: v=137 -> partial-ack -> clients saw mixed region priorities
[2027-08-01T02:14:06Z] tls: handshake-rate +380% across us-west edges
[2027-08-01T02:14:07Z] forwarding: duplicate-flows dropped=840
```

javier: alert thresholds proposed in code:
- "regional_swap_rate": "> 5% for 3m -> pager"
- "tls_handshake_spike": "> 200% for 1m -> SRE"
I'll attach Alert IDs once created.

dee: note on rollback: i'll add a quick rollback-tag in LB control plane so ops can pin previous route version if we detect cross-region spill. will open LB PR after control-plane piece lands.

emily: registrar replied: they're investigating sub-1min TTL behavior and suggested a temporary workaround to push cache-invalidate calls on route change. they recommend adding small debounce on control-plane pushes.

carla: timeline & check-ins: daily standups in this thread for next 5 business days. wrap sync next Thursday 15:00 UTC to confirm all mitigations and close action items.

emily: registrar ticket updated: RG-12198 -> registrar status: "investigating caching edge behavior".

carla: thanks team. please update this thread with PRs / merge notes so I can include in the postmortem follow-up doc.
